items.title: Berkshire Hathaway steps up buybacks as operating profit falls
items.summary: Investing.com - Berkshire Hathaway reported a 5.8% drop in third-quarter operating earnings on Saturday, weighed down by weaker insurance results even as its cash pile climbed to a record $377.4 billion and the conglomerate stepped up share repurchases.
